{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv')

# Fix revenue: remove commas and convert to float
df['revenue'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Filter to only completed orders
df_completed = df[df['status'] == 'completed']

# Identify and remove QA orders (revenue = 999999.99)
qa_orders = df_completed[df_completed['revenue'] == 999999.99]
print(f'Number of QA orders in completed set: {len(qa_orders)}')

# Cleaned dataset
df_completed_clean = df_completed[df_completed['revenue'] != 999999.99]

# Compute mean revenue for completed, non-QA orders
mean_revenue = df_completed_clean['revenue'].mean()
print(f'Mean revenue of completed orders (excluding QA): {mean_revenue}')

# Return the value for submission
mean_revenue"}
